About this place

Excavations at Raghurampur exposed walls and rooms interpreted as part of a Buddhist monastery. The find gives archaeologists material to compare with the inscriptions that mention historical Vikramapura. Nearby Bajrayogini is associated with Atish Dipankar. The archaeological remains and the biographical tradition offer different kinds of evidence.
